wizards.structure: 4 per school (CDM review: '28 cards in each deck (4 cards of each of the 7 schools)'); one unique art/name per school seen. Whether all 4 copies of a school are identical is INFERRED (reviewer shows 'all the unique art' = 7).
wizards.card_text: Wizard cards have no rules text: name, school icon (top right), one reagent icon (top left) = +1 of that reagent whenever you Gather (RB p.10).
wizards.coverage: all 7 unique wizards confirmed from Keith photos (name, school, bonus reagent)

towers.structure: 7 schools x 4 tiers; tier N costs N x school reagent OR N Gold. No ability text.
towers.coverage: complete; verified from Keith photos (all 4 tiers price-confirmed)
towers.note: Prototype tier-4 = 3 Gold is superseded; production is 4 Gold.

unmatched_preproduction_spells.text: +5 Mana whenever a Wizard is recruited
Ignore hit from and eliminate (out of play) the first Monster revealed in your next Dungeon Delving
Protected from all negative Spell effects

Take a Familiar from another player and use it immediately
Steal 1 Gold per 2 Eye of Newt used in casting the Spell (from one player)

Gain 1 Gold/ Card of a School of Magic of your choice

Ignore two hits per Dungeon Delving

solo.rulebook_ai_paragraph: RB p.7: AI starts 30 Mana + 1 random Wizard, no reagent limit, gathers all reagents on card, converts the most-Mana reagent, follows a two-sided 'AI Flow-Chart'.
solo.flowchart_status: NOT PUBLISHED. Solo designer David Digby (BGG 3338169): 'There isn't a flowchart... The solo mode you referenced is not the same as the published version.' The paragraph is a leftover from an abandoned concept.
solo.published_solo: Lizard Wizard: Mechanica Magus (solo design David Digby, original concepts David Turczi): 9 Action cards + 9 Dungeon Delve cards + 8-page rules. Rules PDF is on BGG files for thing 373930 (login required); card proxies in BGG thread 3293703 (images not retrievable without login).
